The main landing gear is equipped with an electric motor powered by an auxiliary power unit which allows the aircraft to push back from the gate and taxi without a tug or its jet engines.  The system weighs 300 kg and is permanently installed on the aircraft.  The system can accelerate the aircraft to 20 knots.
